items.title: Vegetable & Soil Sampling
items.details: Collecting vegetable and soil samples across 34 zones of Dhaka for the trace metal bioaccumulation study.

items.title: River Sediment Collection
items.details: Sediment and water sampling from Dhaka's urban rivers for heavy metal and radioactivity analysis.

items.title: Community FGDs
items.details: Interviews, focus group discussions and surveys with diverse stakeholders for the US Forest Service International Compass Program.

items.title: Urban Survey
items.details: Field surveys on urban inequality indicators for the Fair Urban Transition Phase II project in Khulna.

items.title: Laboratory Work
items.details: Sample preparation and instrumental analysis (AAS, INAA, HPGe) at the Institute of Nuclear Science & Technology, BAEC.

items.title: Wetland Assessment
items.details: Field visits supporting the restoration of Dhaka's urban wetlands.
